mapper.select: SELECT username, nickname, role FROM sys_user WHERE username<>#{me} AND (enabled IS NULL OR enabled=1) ORDER BY role DESC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT username, nickname, role FROM sys_user WHERE username<>#{me} AND (enabled IS NULL OR enabled=1) AND role='admin' AND IFNULL(super_admin,0)=0 AND IFNULL(staff_post,'')='shop_merchant' ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT username, nickname, role FROM sys_user WHERE username<>#{me} AND (enabled IS NULL OR enabled=1) AND role<>'admin' ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT * FROM sys_dm_message WHERE ((from_username=#{me} AND to_username=#{peer}) OR (from_username=#{peer} AND to_username=#{me})) AND id>#{sinceId} ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 200
